note: Pages are written from each provider's public documentation. Every entry has verified false until someone has watched it work on the live page; fix addresses, selectors and patterns here, no code change needed. A field is read only from capture.host on a path matching capture.pathMatch, and only an element matching a selector or sitting beside one of the labels, and only if it fits pattern.

steps.label: Sign in to Twitch
steps.hint: Use your own Twitch account. Turn on two-factor sign-in if Twitch asks; the developer console needs it.

steps.label: Register an application
steps.hint: Name it anything. Category: Application Integration. Client type: Confidential. OAuth redirect URL: http://localhost

steps.label: Open Manage on it
steps.hint: Your application is listed under Applications; its Manage button opens the page with the Client ID.

steps.label: Press New Secret
steps.hint: Twitch shows the Client Secret only once. droidtop reads it the moment it appears.

steps.label: Sign in
steps.hint: Steam sign-in works here. Google, Discord and Twitter may refuse an embedded browser; droidtop then offers the system browser.

steps.label: Open Preferences, API
steps.hint: Your profile menu, Preferences, then the API tab.

steps.label: Show the API key
steps.hint: The key is a 32 character code on the API tab. droidtop offers to use it when it appears.

steps.label: Sign in or register
steps.hint: A free forum account; the key is tied to it.

steps.label: Request an API key
steps.hint: Follow the forum's API access page and fill in the short request.

steps.label: Open your key
steps.hint: A 64 character code. droidtop offers to use it when it appears.

steps.label: Create an account
steps.hint: Free. Pick a username and password you will type once on the next screen.

steps.label: Confirm the email
steps.hint: ScreenScraper emails a confirmation link; open it in the system browser or on your phone.

steps.label: Sign in once
steps.hint: Check the login works here. Your password is never read from this page.
